This document talks about Jinja itself.
A variable looks like {{ user.name }} and a tag looks like {% if x %}.
Comments are written {# like this #}. Raw blocks: {% raw %}{{ x }}{% endraw %}
Edge cases: {{{ triple }}}, {%- trimmed -%}, {#- c -#}, lone { and } and }}.
